title: Pokemon TCG Hydrapple Ex Stellar Crown 014/142 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokémon Hydrapple EX TCG Card #014/142 Sv07: Stellar Crown is a Grass-type Pokémon card with a Dragon creature type. It has an HP of 330, is a Stage 2 card from the Sv07: Stellar Crown set manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2024. This English-language card features a Holo finish and is a Double Rare specialty EX Pokémon designed by illustrator 5ban Graphics for ages 6 and up. With its unique attributes and rarity, this card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
